source.title: Scotch C60 Magic Tape Dispenser with Scotch Magic Tape : 19mm x 33m (4 Rolls)
source.creator: tactless

analysis.study_scope: Physical reference analysis of C60 tape dispenser: attached hub mechanism, pivot point, swing motion, base footprint, and assembly clearances for 3D modeling.

episodes.problem: Analyzing base footprint and underside surface structure for hard-surface housing setup.
episodes.observed_fact: Base features two rectangular non-slip pads positioned on flat end sections with a recessed central text area.
episodes.interpretation: Bottom perimeter comprises two flat contact planes surrounding a shallow central inset.
episodes.hypothesis: Base mesh can be extruded from flat bottom profile with recessed face created via inset.
episodes.reference_evidence: Underside view showing pads, recessed text panel, and outer bevel.
episodes.modeling_decision: Establish base boundary and pad locations relative to main shell geometry.
episodes.visible_action: Dispenser inverted to show bottom rubber pads and base layout.
episodes.alternatives: Modeling flat base without central inset recess.
episodes.transferable_principle: Establish main structural contact planes and pad footprints early using physical reference.

episodes.problem: Determining pivot location and motion path of attached tape hub mechanism.
episodes.observed_fact: Hub comprises a central core on a curved arm hinged at upper rear internal wall of dispenser well.
episodes.interpretation: Hub mechanism operates as single-pivot swing arm rotating upward out of main cavity.
episodes.hypothesis: Model hub arm and core as single mesh asset with pivot origin at rear hinge axle.
episodes.reference_evidence: Hand pulling swing arm upward and backward from resting well position.
episodes.modeling_decision: Set object pivot point at rear hinge location to allow proper rotation.
episodes.visible_action: Opening swing arm hub mechanism upward from housing cavity.
episodes.transferable_principle: Align mechanical object origin directly on physical hinge axis for proper articulated motion.

episodes.problem: Verifying geometric clearances between hub cylinder core, tape roll, and housing cavity.
episodes.observed_fact: Tape roll slides onto central hub cylinder; arm swings down placing roll centered within housing well.
episodes.interpretation: Hub cylinder outer diameter matches tape roll inner core; housing well cutout accommodates full roll radius.
episodes.hypothesis: Apply subtle radius tolerance on hub cylinder to fit tape roll core mesh perfectly.
episodes.reference_evidence: Tape roll mounted onto raised hub core and swung down into housing cavity.
episodes.modeling_decision: Size hub cylinder outer radius to match inner core of standard tape roll model.
episodes.visible_action: Mounting tape roll onto hub arm cylinder and locking down into dispenser body.
episodes.transferable_principle: Maintain accurate radial clearance offsets between mating mechanical parts to avoid mesh intersection.
